finding.text: Every shot is Chrome's "This site can't be reached" page, not the site (req 3, four widths): both pages, all four widths — shots/*/sheet.png; layout.json widest_text_sample "This site can't be reached" at 400/1200/1920/3440. The private server on 127.0.0.1:60833 was down when review.mjs shot, so no layout question can be answered. Re-shoot with the server up.

No screenshot of the tree beside a real demo at 1200 (req 3), and the tree is not "beside" anything: the demo page (instance-tree/page.js) stacks buttons, then the tree, then the doc, in one column. CLAUDE.md "Show the class" asks for the rendered view and the live instance side by side.

The second placement is weaker than asked (req 2): the "live tree" link went into `ext/System/readme.md` and `catalog/readme.md`, which are readmes, not the `ext/System` class card or the catalog's class-cards section. A reader browsing the cards never sees it.

`InstanceTree.render()` wraps `app.navigated` on every mount, and `stop()` never unwraps it. The dev bar re-renders its tabs, so each show/hide adds another wrapper that stays in the chain for the rest of the session (InstanceTree.js, render()).

`install()` patches `Page.prototype.add` for the whole site the first time any tree loads. It is honest about it in the doc, but it is a core hook that lives outside `core/`; once `Property.of` lands, swap it for a real event on Page.
The `Object.js` descriptor fix (no getters run on a prototype) is a good, real bug fix, but it lies outside the fence; say so on the card.
